name: blender
instruction: Blender is a 3D application. IMPORTANT: Blender renders its UI with OpenGL custom fonts. click_text and Windows accessibility are unreliable on Blender UI elements. Prefer Blender API actions: use {"type":"blender_open_import_menu"} to open File > Import, {"type":"blender_import_file","path":"C:\\absolute\\path\\model.fbx"} to import a known file directly, {"type":"blender_create_scene","description":"detailed scene request","expect":{"type":"blender_scene_objects"}} for reference-image/model creation, {"type":"blender_enhance_scene","description":"add professional details to the existing scene","expect":{"type":"blender_scene_objects"}} for polish/detail/MLO verification passes, and {"type":"blender_python","description":"select all objects","script":"import bpy\nbpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')"} for custom bpy operations. If the user asks to import but did not give a path, ask for the path instead of clicking around. CORRECT SHORTCUTS: Ctrl+O=Open file dialog, Ctrl+N=New file, Ctrl+S=Save, Ctrl+Shift+S=Save As, F3=Search any command, Shift+A=Add menu, Tab=Edit/Object mode, G=Move, R=Rotate, S=Scale, X=Delete, Ctrl+Z=Undo. OPENING A SPECIFIC .blend FILE: Use cmd action to launch blender with the file path directly. CRITICAL: Do not claim a Blender menu/model is created unless you used a Blender API action and verified a success result. NEVER use click_text in Blender.
